query: WITH target_ids(id) AS (VALUES ('35742bfa-2280-4748-b23b-5a2372c35b3d'::uuid), ('21cfc0fc-e816-4dcf-b51c-ba6674d4482d'::uuid), ('c59df565-2412-4f7a-84cd-50283d666247'::uuid), ('2a6fe84d-0f03-456a-9091-546e933a9216'::uuid), ('d5644bc5-0762-4eb6-bf89-635a1aef165c'::uuid), ('c4997820-713b-47cd-b69d-de8d678a68fa'::uuid), ('f8a2ad20-2ebb-4cb0-bf28-b9d394dbc258'::uuid), ('0249d2e2-61ab-4fbb-ad6e-f92a475b4bc8'::uuid), ('bd98a0ba-9f5e-4ee2-aa75-6fdcbe8fa6e7'::uuid), ('480171e8-72da-49b5-883a-6eabbff41fd0'::uuid), ('0ba99a28-9859-4897-a072-66daf4d8661a'::uuid), ('4fc683c4-e776-4fe6-a2ab-8647ecb6760f'::uuid)), eligible AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT l.id FROM public.lessons l JOIN target_ids t ON t.id = l.id WHERE NOT COALESCE(l.is_test_data, false) AND length(btrim(COALESCE(l.content, ''))) = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lesson_sessions ls WHERE ls.lesson_id = l.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lesson_sessions ls WHERE ls.lesson_id = l.id AND (COALESCE(ls.is_test_data, false) OR length(btrim(COALESCE(ls.content, ''))) = 0)) ORDER BY l.id LIMIT 12), restored_sessions AS (UPDATE public.lesson_sessions ls SET is_active = true, updated_at = now() WHERE ls.lesson_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible) AND NOT COALESCE(ls.is_test_data, false) RETURNING ls.id), restored_lessons AS (UPDATE public.lessons l SET is_active = true, updated_at = now() WHERE l.id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible) RETURNING l.id), restored_exercises AS (UPDATE public.exercises e SET is_active = true, is_published = true, updated_at = now() WHERE e.lesson_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible) AND NOT COALESCE(e.is_test_data, false) RETURNING e.id), restored_quizzes AS (UPDATE public.quizzes q SET is_active = true, is_published = true, updated_at = now() WHERE q.lesson_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible) AND NOT COALESCE(q.is_test_data, false) RETURNING q.id) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM eligible) AS eligible_lessons, (SELECT count(*) FROM restored_sessions) AS restored_sessions, (SELECT count(*) FROM restored_lessons) AS restored_lessons, (SELECT count(*) FROM restored_exercises) AS restored_exercises, (SELECT count(*) FROM restored_quizzes) AS restored_quizzes;
